Mum: Have you finished your jobs?
Sam: I tidied my room, but I still have to set the table.
Mum: Do you need to wash up too?
Sam: No, Leo is doing that today.
Mum: Did you put the mugs in the cabinet?
Sam: I put them on the shelf instead, as you asked.
Mum: What must you finish before going out?
Sam: My homework. It will take half an hour.
Mum: Where are you meeting Jo?
Sam: At the library, not the shopping centre.
